summary: 009EAE20 and 009EAFC0, the two box refreshes 009F0EA0 runs on every surviving neighbour node once a frame. 009EAE20 rebuilds the near box: the observed hull's own oriented box, centre pushed along its heading by min(settings+1A8h * body-axis speed, unit+9C8h * 0.25), half extents unit+9C8h * 0.55 + |advance| along the bow and unit+9CCh * 0.60 abeam. 009EAFC0 caches the observed hull's world Y bounds in node+80h/+84h, stores the party filter's answer in node+69h, gates on vertical overlap with blk+1BCh/blk+1C0h, and then fills the avoid box node+44h..+64h either by copying the near box or by dead-reckoning the other ship along a line or a turning circle. The node's complete field table is reconciled across 009E52E0, the two refreshes, the sector scan's consumers, the clearance footprints and the traffic separation.

host_steps.evidence: 009EAE41 MOV EAX,[ECX]; 009EAE43 MOV EDX,[EAX+50h]; 009EAE46 CALL EDX; 009EAE48 FSTP [ESI+40h]. The concrete slot in the unit vtable 00CFC3D0 is 006DFD60, FLD dword ptr [ECX+1050h]; RET.
009EAE4B MOV EAX,[ESI+14h]; 009EAE4E MOV ECX,[EAX+1018h]; 009EAE54 CALL. Signed: the result multiplies settings+1A8h at 009EAED0 and a negative product survives the min at 009EAEF3.
009EAEC5 CALL; 009EAECA FLD float ptr [EAX+1A8h]. ShipAvoidance.NearbyShip_PosSpeedCorrig, docs/SHIP_AI_SETTINGS_BLOCK.md.
009EAED4 MOV EDI,[ESI+14h]; 009EAEDB FLD float ptr [EDI+9C8h]; 009EAEE1 FMUL double 0.25 (00D7A348).
009EAF07 CMP byte ptr [EDI+C8h],0; 009EAF2C JNZ skips the refresh.
009EAF2E MOV ECX,EDI; 009EAF30 CALL. Reached only when the byte at step 5 is clear.
009EAF35 FLD float ptr [EDI+FCh]; 009EAF45 FLD float ptr [EDI+104h]. Both are read after step 6, which is why the projection makes the pair a host call rather than an input.
009EAF89 MOV EAX,[ESI+14h]; 009EAF8C FLD float ptr [EAX+9C8h]; 009EAF92 FMUL double 0.55 (00CEC8F0); 009EAF98 FADD |advance|; 009EAF9C FSTP [ESI+38h]. The second read of the same field.
009EAF9F FLD float ptr [EAX+9CCh]; 009EAFA5 FMUL double 0.6 (00CEFF98); 009EAFAB FSTP [ESI+3Ch].
009EAFE8 MOV EAX,[ECX]; 009EAFEA MOV EDX,[EAX+20h]; 009EAFED CALL EDX; 009EAFF1 TEST EAX,EAX. The presence test. Concrete slot 006D1E30, MOV EAX,[ECX+360h]; RET, the same getter 009DE2F0 uses.
009EAFF3 MOV ECX,[ESI+14h]; 009EB005 CALL EDX; 009EB007 MOV ECX,EAX. The second call of the same slot, whose result is the copier's this.

009EAFFA PUSH EAX (the second buffer) and 009EB001 PUSH EDX (the first) are this call's arguments, not the vtable getter's: the getter's RET has no cleanup and 0098A8E0 is RET 8. 009EB00E takes the second buffer's Y into node+80h and 009EB01C the first buffer's Y into node+84h.

009EB05F CALL; 009EB081 MOV EDI,EAX; 009EB087 ADD EDI,180h. EDI is written once and the only POP EDI before 009EB334 is at 009EB2CC, on a path 009EB2B7 skips, so every [EDI+disp] in the body is in this epoch. Ten rows: +20h, +24h, +2Ch, +30h, +34h, +3Ch, +40h, +44h, +50h.
009EB0D6 LEA ECX,[ESP+20h] over the delta rebuilt at 009EB0D3..009EB0E9; 009EB0F5 stores the result and 009EB104/009EB111 multiply both components by it.

009EB0FD MOV EDX,[ECX]; 009EB0FF MOV EDX,[EDX+34h]; 009EB10C PUSH EAX (the out buffer); 009EB119 CALL EDX, RET 4. Concrete slot 00812090: the body axis (unit+94h,+98h,+9Ch) scaled by 0092D730(unit+1018h), returned in the caller's buffer. Only [0] and [2] are read back, at 009EB11B and 009EB125.
009EB1F5 MOV EAX,[ESI+14h]; 009EB1F8 MOV ECX,[EAX+1018h]; 009EB1FE CALL. Signed here: 009EB207..009EB212 makes the travel, whose sign 009EB3D4 tests.
009EB23E MOV ECX,[ESI+14h]; 009EB241 CALL; 009EB246 FMUL double 0.05 (00D7A270). Runs before step 18, which is why the projection sequences both into locals.
009EB24C MOV EAX,[ESI+14h]; 009EB24F MOV ECX,[EAX+1018h]; 009EB259 CALL; 009EB269 AND ECX,7FFFFFFFh takes it absolute, unlike step 16.
009EB331 MOV EBX,[ESI+14h]; 009EB337 LEA ECX,[EBX+9C8h] as the first operand of the 00415550 at 009EB34B, against settings+1B0h.
009EB420 MOV ECX,EBX (the observed unit); 009EB428 CALL; 009EB42D FCHS negates it; 009EB42F scales it by the projection time.

009EB4EC LEA ECX,[ESP+34h] (the out pair); 009EB4F3 FSTP [ESP] (the heading); 009EB4F6 CALL, RET 4. 009EB4FB and 009EB508 read out[0] and out[1] into node+4Ch and node+50h. The containing Ghidra function is FUN_009EB4D1, the arc arm Ghidra split out of 009EAFC0, not 009EAFC0 itself.

call_sites.evidence: 009F1046 LEA ECX,[ESP+30h]; 009F104A PUSH ECX; 009F104B MOV ECX,EDI (the node); 009F104D CALL. The pushed pair is the floored hull velocity and the callee never reads it.
009F10B0 PUSH EDX plus 009F10B1 SUB ESP,18h plus 009F10E5 SUB ESP,8 is the 24h the callee's RET cleans; 009F10F8 MOV ECX,EDI (the node); 009F10FF CALL.
009EB083 LEA ECX,[ESP+20h] over the delta from the node's near centre to this hull; the result loses node+38h at 009EB0A1.
009EB11D LEA ECX,[ESP+38h] points at arguments 2 and 3 and is not reloaded, so this length is this hull's own speed, not the relative one.
009EB18C LEA ECX,[EDI+20h] (settings+1A0h), 009EB193 LEA EDX,[ESP+48h] (the distance threshold divided by the closing speed): the arrival time's floor.
009EB27B LEA ECX,[ESP+14h] (|body-axis speed|), 009EB277 LEA EDX,[ESP+0Ch] (reference speed * 0.05).
009EB288 LEA ECX,[EDI+44h] (settings+1C4h), 009EB28B LEA EDX,[ESP+14h]: the cap on the per-second shrink rate.
009EB312 LEA ECX,[ESP+14h] with 1.0f stored there at 009EB316, 009EB30A LEA EDX,[ESP+38h] with shrink * 6.0 stored at 009EB325.
009EB337 LEA ECX,[EBX+9C8h], 009EB334 LEA EDX,[EDI+30h] (settings+1B0h); the result is scaled by settings+1B4h at 009EB350.
009EB43C LEA ECX,[ESP+4Ch] (the raw turn), 009EB438 LEA EDX,[ESP+44h] (-pi/2, 00CE3CCC), 009EB437 PUSH EDX of [ESP+50h] (+pi/2, 00CE3C64). RET 4.
009EB4D1 SUB ESP,8; 009EB4D4 FSTP [ESP+4] (the turn); 009EB4DB FSTP [ESP] (node+40h); RET 8, which is what makes the following displacements land back in the PUSH EBX/PUSH EDI epoch.

corrections.was: docs/SHIP_AI_SECTOR_SCAN.md node table and include/bsp/ship_ai_sector_scan.hpp: +28h/+2Ch and +30h/+34h are 'the beam and forward axes', named axis_beam_* and axis_forward_*
corrections.is: +28h/+2Ch is the forward axis and +30h/+34h the beam axis. The old names came from the consumers; the producer settles it.
corrections.evidence: 009EAE9D and 009EAEA8 store cos and sin of the observed hull's own folded heading into +28h/+2Ch; 009EAEB8 and 009EAEC0 derive +30h/+34h from them as (+2Ch, -(+28h)).

corrections.is: +38h is the half extent along +28h, so the half length; +3Ch is the half extent along +30h, the half beam. The avoid pair +5Ch/+60h follows them.
corrections.evidence: 009EAF9C stores unit+9C8h * 0.55 + |advance| into +38h and 009EAFAB stores unit+9CCh * 0.60 into +3Ch; 009D8111 and 009D813A in 009D80C0 compare +38h against the +28h projection.

run_time_evidence.evidence: docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2p records the neighbour list empty in the validation process: 009EF230 runs 15680 times and marks nothing because 009F0D20 never appends. Both routines here run only inside that list's ageing loop, so bsp_game.exe cannot reach either. Every claim in the doc is static, from the listing.

no_ghidra_function.evidence: Start: the pointer stored at 00CFC3D0+50h, the vtable slot 009EAE46 calls; python tools/bsp.py ghidra proto 006DFD60 --brief reports no function there, only the enclosing candidate 006DFD20. End: disasm-raw reads 006DFD60 FLD dword ptr [ECX+1050h] (6 bytes) and 006DFD66 RET (1 byte) from the disk image, with INT3 padding 006DFD67..006DFD6F and the next accessor at 006DFD70.
no_ghidra_function.note: Read only to give the indirect host method observed_heading_vtable50 a contract. Nothing is projected from it and no name is claimed for it, so defining it is optional.

uncertainties: unit+9C8h and unit+9CCh are read as the hull's full length and full beam. Three uses agree (009F1987's admission radius (self+9C8h + other+9C8h) * 0.5, include/bsp/ship_ai_hull_geometry.hpp's unit_full_beam_09cc, and the 0.55/0.60 scalings here), but docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md records that +9C8h has no producer anywhere and include/bsp/ship_ai_arm_final_step.hpp calls it a hull radius. If it is a radius, every extent in this packet is twice what it should be.
node+64h has no located reader. Twenty-one node-touching routines were grepped for it and none reads it.
00424C40 is called twice per node per frame, once from each refresh (009EAEC5, 009EB05F). Whether that is deliberate is not established; the projection keeps both calls.

The concrete vtable bodies are read from 00CFC3D0, which is the unit's table on two independent readings, but nothing proves the observed unit at node+14h is of that exact class rather than a subclass overriding +20h, +34h or +50h.
Whether node+68h set by the collapse arm at 009EB2C5 is meant to persist is not settled: 009F0EA0 clears nothing and 009EB076 clears it only after the vertical gate passes.
